'''Dem Keval''' was a [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] who was appointed as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Tasked with governing the world and ensuring that Tasariq remained free as long as the appropriate taxes were paid, Governor Keval levied a heavy tariff on off-world goods.<ref name="J15" />
